lesson.elephant_from_shapes.title: Elephant From Shapes
lesson.elephant_from_shapes.summary: Build a large elephant from simple connected forms, then use overlap and proportion to make the body feel solid before adding your own character details.
lesson.elephant_from_shapes.step.body_ma: Begin with one broad body mass. Keep it large enough to leave room for the head, legs and trunk.
lesson.elephant_from_shapes.help.body_hi: Think about the body as one big simple form first. Details can wait.
lesson.elephant_from_shapes.complete.bod: The large body shape gives the elephant its main scale.
lesson.elephant_from_shapes.step.head: Attach the head, ear and trunk. Compare their size to the body instead of drawing each part separately.
lesson.elephant_from_shapes.help.head_hi: Keep the head smaller than the body, let the ear overlap it, and allow the trunk to flow downward in one clear direction.
lesson.elephant_from_shapes.complete.hea: The connected head, ear and trunk now read as one construction.
lesson.elephant_from_shapes.step.legs: Add the near and far legs so they overlap the body at believable places. Keep their lengths related to the body height.
lesson.elephant_from_shapes.help.legs_hi: Place the legs under the weight of the body. One leg can sit slightly behind another instead of all four competing for the same outline.
lesson.elephant_from_shapes.complete.leg: The overlap and scale make the elephant feel grounded.
lesson.elephant_from_shapes.step.face: Add a simple eye, mouth, back contour and tail. These marks refine the silhouette without turning into tiny-detail copying.
lesson.elephant_from_shapes.help.face_hi: Use only the landmarks that help the form read clearly. Keep the eye and mouth small compared with the head.
lesson.elephant_from_shapes.complete.fac: The main proportions and contour now hold together as an elephant.
lesson.elephant_from_shapes.step.make_yo: Give this elephant your own gesture or setting. Change the ear marks, trunk movement, ground, mood or another detail you care about.
lesson.elephant_from_shapes.help.make_yo: Choose one change that gives the elephant personality. It does not need to match the teacher example.
lesson.elephant_from_shapes.complete.dra: You built the elephant from proportion and overlap, then made the final choices your own.
